title: [bundle] Fix audit-found agent navigation gap: hf has no successful h
objective: Fix audit-found agent navigation gap: hf has no successful help entry point. `hf --help`, `hf help`, `hf fleet --help`, and `hf task --help` currently exit nonzero or misroute, which makes simple agent navigation conflict-prone. Add first-class help handling so top-level help exits 0, nested help for grouped commands exits 0 with focused usage, and unknown commands still fail closed. Add tests for the help paths and keep docs/help usage in sync.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level help paths `hf --help` and `hf help` exit 0 and print an agent-oriented usage surface.
Grouped help paths `hf fleet --help`, `hf help fleet`, `hf task --help`, `hf help task`, `hf prompt-hub --help`, and `hf help prompt-hub` exit 0 with focused usage.
Unknown commands continue to fail closed with exit code 2.
Regression coverage exists in hf/tests/cli.rs and the hf CLI test target is green.
